LG's most popular OLED TV in 2026 is on sale well for Black Friday. Amazon currently has the 65" LG Evo C6 4K OLED TV for $1,299.98 with free delivery. Amazon Prime cardholders can also get an additional 10% cashback (instead of 5%). Even if you can't get the cashback, this is the lowest straight-up price I've seen so far this year by $100. If you're looking for the best gaming TV, the LG C6 OLED should top your list.

Black Friday Deal: 52% Off 2026 65" LG Evo C6 4K OLED TV

The C6 is LG's current 2026 model in the LG's C-series OLED TV lineup. LG's C-series OLED TV in general has been our favorite TVs for console gaming for many years thanks to its outstanding image quality, low input lag, and high refresh rate. This is also one of the best TVs you can get for streaming 4K HDR content in its intended glory. OLED TVs boast superior image quality compared to most other TVs thanks to their near-infinite black levels, near-infinite contrast ratio, and near-instantaneous response times. The C6 is also equipped with LG's proprietary Evo panel, which is significantly brighter and offers a wider color gamut than traditional W-OLED TVs.

C6 is a perfect complement to current generation consoles like the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X. It features a native 120Hz panel that can be pushed to as high as 165Hz, HDMI 2.1 ports across all four inputs, adaptive sync with variable refresh rate (including support for NVIDIA G-Sync and AMD FreeSync Premium), and auto low latency mode.

If you want a really big screen, consider a projector instead

If you're aiming for a TV that's bigger than 75", you might want to consider a projector instead. XGIMI makes wonderfully compact yet capable laser projectors in its Horizon series and they're discounted by up to 40% off during Black Friday. The Horizon projectors are easy enough to move around and you don't have to worry about an enormous black screen cluttering your wall when you're not using it.
